title: Poops configuration
description: Configuration for Poops — a bundler and static site generator driven by one poops.json. https://stamat.info/poops

additionalProperties.description: A block owned by a companion package that reads the same poops.json — septic's `septic`, say. Poops ignores it, and warns unless a package by that name is in your dependencies. Nothing here can validate that, so an object under an unrecognised name is allowed through; a misspelt Poops key holding an array, string or boolean is still caught.

$schema.description: URL or path of this schema. Ignored by Poops; editors read it for completion and validation.

scripts.description: JavaScript / TypeScript bundles, built with esbuild. One entry or an array of them.

styles.description: Sass / SCSS / CSS bundles, compiled with Dart Sass. One entry or an array of them.

postcss.description: PostCSS pass over CSS — Tailwind, Autoprefixer, any PostCSS plugin. Separate pipeline from `styles`; needs `postcss` installed (npm i -D postcss).

reactor.description: React components rendered to static HTML at build time, with an optional hydration bundle.

markup.description: Templates (Nunjucks or Liquid, plus Markdown) compiled into a static site.

images.description: Responsive image processing via poops-images (optional peer dependency — a missing install warns and skips). The value is a poops-images config object.

copy.description: Files and directories copied into the output. One entry or an array of them.

exec.description: Shell commands run after a pipeline stage compiles — in watch as well as in a build.

banner.description: Comment stamped on top of every output file. Templatable via mustache from your package.json: {{ name }}, {{ version }}, {{ homepage }}, {{ license }}, {{ author }}, {{ description }}, plus {{ year }} for the current year.
examples: /* {{ name }} v{{ version }} | {{ homepage }} | {{ license }} License */

serve.description: Local dev server. Remove the key to skip serving.

livereload.description: Reload the browser when a build finishes. Rides the `serve` port, so it needs `serve` to be on; a CSS-only build hot-swaps stylesheets instead of reloading.

watch.description: Paths to watch for changes. `true` derives the list from every task's `in` path.

includePaths.description: Roots to resolve imports from (Sass @use, script imports). Defaults to ["node_modules"] — setting this replaces the default, so include node_modules yourself.

pkg.description: Internal. Package data used to fill banner templates; Poops reads your package.json for this on its own.

reactorData.description: Internal. Rendered `reactor` HTML, set by Poops between the reactor and markup stages.

esbuildSourcemap.description: Sourcemaps for the unminified output. Passed to esbuild, so its string modes work too.

justMinified.description: Keep only the minified file — the unminified twin is deleted after it is written. Needs `minify`.

in.description: Entry point, an array of them, or a glob (globs use / on every platform). A glob-matched index.* is named after its directory.

out.description: Output file or directory. With several inputs it must be a directory. Also accepts a template — {{dir}} (the match's directory relative to the glob's static prefix) and {{name}} (its basename) — naming one output per matched entry, extension included.

options.description: esbuild build options. The listed ones are what Poops documents; anything else esbuild accepts is merged through.

jsx.description: JSX transform mode. `automatic` is the React 17+ runtime, which needs no React import per file.

nodePaths.description: Extra resolution roots, merged with the top-level includePaths.

in.description: Entry point, an array of them, or a glob (globs use / on every platform, and skip Sass partials, `_*.scss`). A glob-matched index.* is named after its directory.

out.description: Output file or directory. With several inputs it must be a directory. Also accepts a {{dir}}/{{name}} template, as `scripts` does.

sourcemap.description: Write a .css.map beside the unminified output.

tokenPaths.description: Directories of JSON design token files, enabling `@use "token:<name>"` in SCSS. W3C DTCG and Style Dictionary formats are auto-detected.

tokenOutput.description: Shape design tokens compile to: flat SCSS variables, or nested Sass maps.

resolveAliases.description: Resolve {path.to.token} alias references in design tokens.

plugins.description: Plugins to load, in order. A package name, or [name, options] to configure one.

component.description: File default-exporting the React component, rendered at build time with renderToString.

inject.description: Template global the rendered HTML is exposed as, in both engines.

in.description: Client hydration entry. Omit it (with `out`) for server rendering only.

out.description: Output path for the client bundle.

options.description: esbuild options for the client bundle — the same set a `scripts` entry takes.

in.description: Source path, an array of them, or a glob / extglob pattern (POSIX character classes like [[:alpha:]] are not supported).

images.description: poops-images configuration. Poops does not own these keys — the full reference is at https://github.com/stamat/poops-images#configuration.

out.description: Output directory. Keep it out of `in` and outside the watched sources, so generated variants don't retrigger the build.

sizes.description: Responsive widths to generate, plus any named crops.

format.description: Target formats, or "smart" to keep whichever of JPEG/WebP comes out smaller.

verbose.description: Log every file instead of one summary line.

exec.description: A command, or an array of commands run in order, per stage. A bare stage key runs after the stage, `post:` is its explicit spelling, `pre:` runs before it instead. Commands run from the project root; a failure fails a `poops -b` build's exit code, and is logged and swallowed in watch so the watcher survives.

pre:markup.description: Before markup renders — where a generator writing data the templates read belongs.

pre:styles.description: Before Sass compiles — the far end of the style pipeline, since `styles` fires after PostCSS.

styles.description: After the CSS is final — this fires after PostCSS, not after Sass.

post:styles.description: After the CSS is final — this fires after PostCSS, not after Sass.

pre:build.description: Once, before the pipeline starts — not per watch rebuild.

build.description: Once, after the full initial pipeline — not per watch rebuild.

post:build.description: Once, after the full initial pipeline — not per watch rebuild.

port.description: Port to serve on; the CLI --port/-p overrides it. A busy port is stepped over, up to +10.

base.description: Directory the built HTML lives in. Defaults to the markup `out`.

markupEntry.description: Unknown keys here are the 1.x placement of the `options` keys — still read in 2.x with a warning, gone in 3.0.

in.description: Templates directory. Directories starting with _ are not compiled.

out.description: Output directory. Defaults to the working directory.

engine.description: Template engine: a builtin name, or a module specifier / path exporting a custom engine class.

data.description: JSON or YAML data files, relative to `in`. Each becomes a global named after its basename, with spaces, dashes and dots replaced by underscores.

includePaths.description: Directories added to the engine's include paths, so a layout or partial can be included by bare name.

dateFormat.description: Default format for the `date` filter, in dayjs tokens.

timeDateFormat.description: Deprecated: renamed to `dateFormat` in 2.0. Still read, with a warning; gone in 3.0.

baseURL.description: Prefix `relativePathPrefix` resolves to, instead of a per-page relative path. For deploying under a subdirectory. The CLI --base-url/-u overrides it.

site.description: Global data every template reads as `site`. Add anything you want available site-wide; the keys below are the ones Poops itself reads.

title.description: Site title. Also the default llms.txt title and feed channel title.

description.description: Site description. Also the default llms.txt summary and feed description.

url.description: Absolute site URL. Makes sitemap, llms.txt, robots.txt and feed links absolute.

logo.description: Site logo, read by the SEO and JSON-LD filters.

lang.description: Default language — the <html lang> attribute and JSON-LD inLanguage. A page's front-matter `lang` wins.

jsonld.description: Site-wide JSON-LD defaults, merged over the generated ones and still overridable per page.

title.description: Title for pages 2..N and taxonomy term pages. Tokens: {title}, {n}, {total}.

repo.description: Repository URL, for "Edit this page" links. Falls back to package.homepage.

branch.description: Branch those edit links point at.

collections.description: Collections to build, each naming a direct subdirectory of `in`. A collection can also declare itself in its index page's front matter.

oneOf.description: Directory name, with default sorting and no pagination.

paginate.description: Items per page. Without it the index renders once.

collectionSort.description: Sort order. A bare field name, or an object. Sorting by `date` compares dates and defaults to desc; any other field compares alphabetically and defaults to asc.

taxonomies.description: Front-matter fields turned into their own paginated term pages, rendered with the collection's own index template.

oneOf.description: Field name, also used as the URL segment.

path.description: URL segment, and the term-page title label. Defaults to `name`.

paginate.description: Per-term page size. Defaults to the collection's `paginate`.

searchIndex.description: JSON search index of every page. A string names the output file and takes the defaults.

out.description: Output filename, written into the markup output directory.

minWordLength.description: Shortest word that can become a keyword.

globalFrequencyCeiling.description: Drop words appearing on more than this fraction of pages — they discriminate nothing.

stopWords.description: Omit for the bundled English list, `false` to filter nothing, an inline array, or a path to a JSON array file (from the project root).

sitemap.description: sitemap.xml of every page. A string names the output file.

out.description: Output filename, written into the markup output directory.

llms.description: llms.txt — a Markdown index of your pages for LLMs and generative engines. A string names the output file.

out.description: Output filename, written into the markup output directory.

intro.description: Markdown file (from the project root) inserted as free-form context between the summary and the link sections. Avoid ## headings in it — they read as sections.

sectionTitle.description: Heading for the lead section of root-level pages.

full.description: Also write the full-content corpus — every Markdown page's body in one file. `true` derives the name from `out` (llms.txt → llms-full.txt); a string sets the path.

fullIntro.description: Markdown file (from the project root) inserted into the full-content file after its header. The `full` counterpart to `intro`; a missing file warns and is skipped.

robots.description: robots.txt. A string names the output file and writes an allow-all with a Sitemap: line.

out.description: Output filename, written into the markup output directory.

allow.description: Path or paths to explicitly allow.

sitemap.description: An explicit Sitemap: URL, or `false` to omit the line. Derived from your generated sitemap by default.

nav.description: Navigation tree — the `nav` template global, plus a nested JSON file for client-side rendering. A string names the output file.

out.description: Output filename, written into the markup output directory.

collections.description: `true` nests every collection page under its collection; `false` excludes them all; an array allowlists collections; "index" keeps only each collection's landing page, as a leaf.

home.description: Keep the site's root index page in the tree.

root.description: Scope the tree to a subdirectory; its children are emitted at the top level, with the section's own index pinned first.

feed.description: RSS or Atom feed from a collection. `true` or a filename emits an RSS feed for every collection; an array generates several feeds at once.

collection.description: Collection to feed from. Omit it for a feed per collection.

out.description: File to write. A bare filename lands in the collection's own folder; a path with a slash is used as-is under the output directory.

content.description: Add each post's full article HTML — RSS <content:encoded>, Atom <content type="html">. Markdown posts only.
